verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions connecting ByteAsk to Jira, Slack, Google Drive, or any other workflow tool to extend the agent's context. The documented connectors are IDE integrations (VS Code, Cursor, JetBrains), and the official MCP server serves embedded reference docs. Both are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the agent to workflow tools like Jira, Slack, and Google Drive to extend its context
